description.en: Registers a numeric value substitution for the given placeholder index, so the next opened message can embed a computed number (e.g. an amount gained) at that placeholder.
Index of the placeholder within the message text to substitute.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Substitute a numeric value into the next message's placeholder 1
CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_VAL(1, lost_pt);
